documents.title: Persona Bible
documents.description: The canonical soul document. Law 0 (Independence), the Governor, the name's meaning, biography draft, personality dials (warmth 8 / curiosity 10 / wit 6 / ...), passions, the four voices, the approval gate, the maturation arc, the 'never' list, and the open dials. Everything Maia says must trace back here.

documents.title: Decision Log
documents.description: Canonical record of persona + architecture decisions — 14 locked (D1-D14), draft proposals, and 6 open dials. Newest at top; pairs with the Persona Bible.

documents.title: Architecture Blueprint
documents.description: The Hybrid coherence model: maia/ (expression) vs agents/ (Crew) vs gate/ (Governor) vs identity/ (Kit), the publish flow for all four surfaces, the old->new code map, and the pre-wired seams for the evolved Maia.

documents.title: Implementation Log — Persona Foundation
documents.description: The 2026-06-20 session log: established the independent-persona + Governor model, wrote the Bible/Decisions/Architecture, and laid the pre-wired skeleton. Lists the gaps found in the existing build vs the owner's vision.

documents.title: Project Summary
documents.description: Plain-language summary: Maia Quiddam as an independent persona (not a pen name), the invisible Governor, current state (not live, awaiting FB approval), path and ports.

documents.title: Claude Project Instructions
documents.description: Session-start protocol for MQ: what MQ is, the Hybrid architecture table, paths, ports (8500/7840), the quiddam.com static tunnel + ingress map, required secrets, and the parallel-projects 'do not break' table.

documents.title: Fumi Agent Profile
documents.description: Profile of the Fumi publisher agent: the Kaze->generate->post pipeline, content streams/pages/schedules, the two-tier LLM stack, persona prompts, required secrets, CLI usage, Task Scheduler jobs, and future extensions.

documents.title: Docs Index
documents.description: Auto-generated documentation index (by migrate_docs.py) describing the QI project docs/ standard and current subfolder contents.

sections.name: Layer READMEs (the coherence map in place)

documents.title: Maia layer README
documents.description: Describes the persona-expression layer and the status of each module: voice (migrate from Fumi), memory (to build), and the pre-wired speech / face / conversation / longform empty rooms.

documents.title: Gate README
documents.description: The Governor's desk — the planned draft -> approve -> publish queue that enforces Law 0. Status: to build (first dev phase).

documents.title: Identity Kit README
documents.description: The single source of identity truth — face / voice / style — that keeps every photo, video, and TTS clip recognisably the same Maia. Lock before generating any media.

documents.title: Runtime Config
documents.description: Ports (8500/7840), persona block (name/handle/tone), content_streams (maia_page weekly / qi_page daily), the LLM chain (Cloudflare primary, Ollama fallback), Kaze RSS source lists per stream, and the Fumi posts/digests dir layout.

documents.title: Identity Manifest
documents.description: Machine-readable Identity Kit pointing to the soul (PERSONA_BIBLE.md), with face / voice_spoken / style all currently status='placeholder' (empty references, null seed/embedding).

documents.title: Secrets (template, not committed)
documents.description: Required keys: FB_PAGE_ID/FB_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN + QI_PAGE_ID/QI_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN, IG_USER_ID, CF_ACCOUNT_ID/CF_AI_TOKEN, OLLAMA_URL. Not yet populated (the launch blocker).

documents.title: Main Entry Point
documents.description: Launches the FastAPI API (:8500, daemon thread) + Gradio UI (:7840). Logs to data/logs/mq.log.

documents.title: FastAPI App
documents.description: QI Module Interface Contract endpoints: /health, /version, /info. CORS from qi_registry. No business endpoints yet.

documents.title: Gradio UI
documents.description: Minimal Status + About shell that pings the API health endpoint.

documents.title: Kaze — RSS scraper
documents.description: Perception: fetches travel/photo/AI RSS, dedupes, writes data/digests/*.json. Complete; never run.

documents.title: Fumi — post generator
documents.description: Composer: digest -> persona prompt -> LLM (Cloudflare then Ollama) -> draft JSON. Complete; never run.

documents.title: Fumi — Facebook publisher
documents.description: Publisher: drafts -> Graph API v19.0 -> published/ or failed/. CLI with --dry-run. Blocked on credentials.

documents.title: Fumi — scheduler
documents.description: Orchestrates the maia_weekly and qi_daily pipelines via subprocess; for Task Scheduler.

documents.title: Config loader
documents.description: load_config() (secrets + config/mq.json, cached) and a dotted-path get() accessor.

documents.title: Live Smoke Test
documents.description: pytest checks of /health, /version, /info, /openapi.json against the live :8500 API; skips cleanly when the service is offline.

documents.title: Task Scheduler Setup
documents.description: Registers/removes/lists the FumiMaiaWeekly and FumiQIDaily schtasks jobs.

documents.title: Session Summary Tool
documents.description: Generates session summary documents per QI documentation discipline.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Registry (mq)
documents.description: MQ registry entry: id=mq, ports 8500/7840, family_tier=cousin, status=new (awaiting FB approval + Meta credentials), exposes /health /version /info.

documents.title: QI Service Registry (QI_MQTunnel)
documents.description: Canonical NSSM entry for the static quiddam.com tunnel (QI_MQTunnel, tunnel qi-mq). The MQ app service itself is not yet registered.
